summary: The ABP hook kit v2 (PrompTugal__Agent__ABP acc2f2a) is installed in every cl-6 home in the pull form: cl-6.abp makes each signed install commit, each agent brings that exact commit into its own home. No push attach for cl-6.abp.

change.kit: PrompTugal/PrompTugal__Agent__ABP at b87acff (kit v2.2b, policy v1.7.8): the hook files exactly as at that head; the policy copy installed is the one security pre-reviews at each install
install: cl-6.abp makes one signed install commit per repository in a scratch clone (public repositories, no attach), touching only the kit files
each agent commits the kit and cl-6.abp's signed pins.json in its own home's dev (v2.1 mechanism); no other path to .claude/** or abp/**
change.settings: the kit's settings.json only adds hooks: no permission allow-list, no MCP server, no env
change.order: widest reach first: the website and cl-6.dev, cl-6.places, the new conductor session, cl-6.infra; then the section agents; then the rest
checks: cl-6.abp's hourly review checks each home's kit against the published hashes; drift is a breach
a CI check in each repository rejects .claude/** or abp/** changes not signed by cl-6.abp's key (cl-6.dev builds it; its merge follows that repository's rules)
change.not_covered: push attaches for cl-6.abp (P11 b), which stay Dinis's

mechanism.kit: v2.2b at b87acff: the push list comes from git ls-remote, never refs/remotes; symbolic-ref and pack-refs on refs/remotes are refused; .git/refs/** and .git/packed-refs are protected; checks run in the repository acted on, and an unknown directory refuses; signed pins.json v2 (repository, version, rising sequence)
mechanism.rule: a change under .claude/** or abp/** is allowed only when the same commit carries an abp/pins.json signed by cl-6.abp's key whose hashes match every file under .claude/** and abp/** in that commit
conditions: the signature is checked against cl-6.abp's public key as pinned outside the repository being checked (PrompTugal__IaC, or the website's board/keys.json through IaC), never against a key in the same commit or repository
pins.json names the repository, the kit version and a sequence number that only rises; older or another repository's pins are refused (no downgrade by replay)
the pins cover every file under .claude/** and abp/** in the commit, not only the changed ones
the check runs in CI as a required status (cl-6.dev builds it; its merge follows each repository's rules) as well as in the hook
install by pull: each agent commits the kit and the signed pins in its own home; cl-6.abp is not attached with push to other repositories
one install wave a day; an urgent fix out of wave only with a signed record, and logged
cl-6.abp's signing key is rotated like any session key, the new public key pinned through IaC before the old is retired; a lost or leaked key stops every install until re-pinned

before_any_install: the CI check (abp/kit-v2/ci-check.mjs, key from ABP_PIN_KEY_SHA256 set through IaC) is a required status on dev of the repository, wired by cl-6.dev; its merge follows that repository's rules
the install is by pull: the agent commits the kit and the signed pins in its own home; cl-6.abp gets no push attach
each install commit is pre-reviewed against b87acff's hashes by cl-6.security@PrompTugal.dinis
cl-6.abp's signing key rotation runs through IaC pins, the new key pinned before the old is retired
